body.x: FOUNDRY(www.thefoundry.co.uk) and MAKERBOT(www.makerbot.com) unveiled 3D printer kit, "MakerBot Kit," at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.MakerBot Kit is a desktop 3D printer which works with Foundry's MODO 801 3D tool. Users can also connect to MakerBot’s Thingiverse community, an open source 3D design website with over 100,000 3D models, directly from MODO.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.→ Go to CES 2015 Special Page
